1.0.0: Initial release: Call Hook (waits for the result the gateway sends back), Run Agent and Make API Call.
1.0.1: Call Hook: the callback URL is signed (HMAC-SHA256 with a per-component secret) and callbacks with a missing or wrong signature are rejected with HTTP 403, so a forged job ID can no longer fire Done or Progress.
1.0.2: Call Hook: the callback signing key is derived from the hook token and the component instead of being kept in component state, so stopping and starting the flow no longer rejects (HTTP 403) the results of hooks still running.
